dedupe_keys.name: cde england catchment data explorer r client

description: cde is an R client for the Environment Agency Catchment Data Explorer in England. The JOSS paper describes functions for finding waterbodies and obtaining status classifications, pressures, objectives, measures and protected-area information. The own repository identifies the package; its DESCRIPTION gives GPL-3 even though GitHub has no licence classifier. Spatial coverage is the English catchment or river-basin district queried, and temporal coverage follows the agency releases and selected years. The client can help prepare water-quality or catchment-pressure inputs to water-management simulations. The underlying data source is already recorded as data-england-catchment-data-explorer-river-basin-management; this draft covers the separate R software. A caveat is that classifications and measures are administrative observations, not verified hydraulic or contaminant-transport predictions. Agency API availability and data definitions can change. The article, own README and DESCRIPTION were read without downloading catchment tables.
name: cde England Catchment Data Explorer R client
notes: G5 G5-0764. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
